en.topic_title: More than half of fire-hit Wang Fuk Court homeowners have signed contracts to sell flats to gov’t, Hong Kong leader says
en.topic_summary:
More than half of homeowners of the fire-hit Wang Fuk Court have signed contracts selling their flats to the government under a buyback plan, the city’s leader John Lee has said.



Wang Fuk Court on May 4, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.



Chief Executive Lee said on Monday that 53 per cent of Wang Fuk Court homeowners had signed the sale and purchase agreement, adding that the entire process has been “smooth.”
